courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: Pioneering Spirit 工程船
related.why: 比較兩個系統的負載、能源或資料介面，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare load, energy or data interfaces and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 船體尺度、載荷條件、海況及驗證目的必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Vessel scale, load conditions, sea state and verification purpose require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本專題以測深走時與海床基準建立起點，接到纜體浮重的尺度的系統介面，最後用路由證據與施工限制整合證據。這是原創教學進程，不是假稱現場工程紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Begin with Sounding time and seabed datum, connect through Submerged cable-weight scale, then integrate evidence using Route evidence and construction limits. This is an original teaching progression, not a claimed field record.

history.title: 海底電纜敷設規劃
history.text: 本專題以測深走時與海床基準建立起點，接到纜體浮重的尺度的系統介面，最後用路由證據與施工限制整合證據。這是原創教學進程，不是假稱現場工程紀錄。
history.textEn: Begin with Sounding time and seabed datum, connect through Submerged cable-weight scale, then integrate evidence using Route evidence and construction limits. This is an original teaching progression, not a claimed field record.

courses.connection: 以海床剖面、纜長、彎曲和路由資料建立敷設規劃練習，不提供現場張力控制操作。 在海纜路由與剖面規劃室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
courses.connectionEn: Practice route planning from seabed profiles, length, curvature and data without field tension-control instructions. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Subsea-cable route/profile studio. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
